blurb: Greenfield Lakes Golf Course features an 18-hole par 62 course with a mix of par 3s, par 4s, and par 5s. The facility includes a misted and covered driving range with lighting and a lit practice green. Lessons and clinics are available for all skill levels, including specialized clinics for seniors and juniors.
